title: Case study challenging behavior
descriptions: Processed data (imputed), meta-data, and R codes used for analyses can be found here. If you want to replicate main analyses of the findings, you can use pre-processed dataset 'data_case.csv', with meta-data 'meta_data_case.pdf'. Please see 'Rscript_case.html' which should enable replication of these main findings. Link to same and other scripts/materials= https://osf.io/xrmhu/?view_only=952d536450f44c64bcef661da3c4d7bd
